#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, B;
    std::cin >> n >> B;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
    }
    std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, std::greater<int>> differences;
    int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++evenCount;
        } else {
            ++oddCount;
        }
        if (evenCount == oddCount) {
            differences.push(std::abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    int total = 0;
    while (B >= 0 && !differences.empty()) {
        B -= differences.top();
        if (B < 0) break;
        differences.pop();
        ++total;
    }
    std::cout << total << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
